text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the hectic, hard-fought days
had finally settled down—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Not here.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (It seems the specialized book I ordered has arrived, but... I wonder where it is... Hm? That's—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Admire Groove happened to find the hot spring trip ticket
that had been put on hold and completely forgotten about.
choice_data_list: Isn't the expiration date almost up?!
The expiration date's almost up!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "...You must have kept it safe all this time, Trainer."
choice_data_list: Wanna go with Duramente or someone on our next day off?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: She won't be around for a while due to family business.
choice_data_list: Then Air Groove—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Lately, every weekend,
she's been flying all over the place with "Sensei."
choice_data_list: What should I do...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...It would be best if you and I went together.
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Turning vouchers for a hot spring inn of this caliber into scrap paper...
There's a limit to how foolish one can be."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any races scheduled, so that's convenient.
Or... did you have other plans for the weekend?
choice_data_list: ...There's spectacularly nothing here.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well then, it's settled.
See you this weekend.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swept along by the irresistible momentum,
a sudden trip was decided upon—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the trip—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—The highway bus isn't coming. It might have gotten
stuck in traffic along the way."
choice_data_list: Trouble right off the bat...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Panicking won't make the bus arrive any faster, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The bus arrived a little while later, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "As a result, their arrival at the hot spring resort was severely delayed, and they missed their lunch reservation."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The popular restaurant appeared to be fully booked until nighttime, leaving the two of us standing there on empty stomachs.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It was beyond our control, but... what shall we do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We could try scouting out another restaurant right now,
but if we're just gonna end up waiting in line anyway, maybe—
choice_data_list: Now that it's come to this, let's go on a total street food spree...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Well, that is fine with me regardless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With a steak skewer in my right hand, grilled dango in my left, and a bag of onsen manju hanging from my arm, Admire Groove looks at me with sheer bewilderment.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ……You bought way too much.
choice_data_list: At times like this, holding back is just a waste.
Holding back at a time like this would be a waste, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove also browses around, carefully selects a treat, and eats it right in front of the shop.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
! This smooth red bean paste...
The flavor of the azuki beans is... so rich...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To an outsider, her reaction makes it almost impossible to read her feelings, but as long as she's enjoying herself in her own way, that's what matters.
choice_data_list: Alright, next up is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Plans may go awry, but the one who enjoys the trip wins.
I want to make this journey as memorable as possible for her."
choice_data_list: Hurry! The monkey street performance is starting soon!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...That's what happens when you push yourself to buy tickets for the earlier showing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rushing from one tourist spot to the next in quick succession—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: (She's just been staring at the local mascot...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And furthermore—
choice_data_list: Aren't there too many people on your souvenir list?
Aren't there too many people on your souvenir list?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It is necessary for "Sensei" and those around them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We spent way too much time at the souvenir shop—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm running to the bus stop.
You run, too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After winging it so hard we nearly missed our bus,
we finally arrived at the inn—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While washing away my daily fatigue in the renowned hot springs and savoring a lavish dinner...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because I pigged out on street food earlier today,
midway through dinner turned into a battle against fullness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Admire Groove seemed to thoroughly
enjoy her lavish dinner.
choice_data_list: I... I can't eat another bite...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: You brought this upon yourself.
choice_data_list: Still... it became a wonderful memory.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Though all our plans went out the window
since morning and turned into a complete mess.
choice_data_list: Things like this are actually harder to forget, though.
Things like this are actually harder to forget, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This trip might not end up being
the greatest memory of her life. But—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after she finds "the best journey of her life"
or a "romantic journey" someday, it will never fade.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unpredictable, chaotic, and unglamorous.
You couldn't plan a trip this comical even if you tried.
choice_data_list: You can never have too many funny memories.
You can never have too many funny memories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if each is just a trivial anecdote, it's a one-of-a-kind journey experienced together.
All the more so if it's something to laugh about.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Is that... how it works?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...However, surely a slightly more
relaxing trip would have been fine too."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...So next time, let's at least have
a backup plan in mind."
choice_data_list: ...Yeah. That's true.
...Yeah. You're right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond between myself and Admire Groove...
